decisions.reason: The blurb reflow is a separate correction stated in the same message and is already represented by its own complete MODIFY; the title-style decision does not change it.
The message reiterates the existing layered PSD, PDF, and JPG deliverables without changing them; the title-style decision has no effect on the required formats.
Matching the spine and back title typography to the front is one of the specifically permitted corrections and does not alter the existing no-redesign constraint.
